paite: Huchi in ka kihei a ni nuai a nuaisiahna hih a om tengteng ka mu a; huan ngai in, huchibang a nuaisiah a omte, lungmuanpa neiloute; huan amau nuaisiahte lam ah thilhihtheihna a-om a, himahleh lungmuanpa anei kei uh.
heading: Damsung A Hoihloute

paite: Huaiziak in misite asi khinsate adam lai dam a omlaite sang in ka phat zaw.
Ahi, a-om ngei nai lou, ni nuai a nasep gilou hih a om mu ngei nailoumi amaute sang in ka ngai thupizaw hi.
Huchi in sepgimna leh nasep siamna tengteng, hiai ziak a mihing invengte hazat a omna ka muta hi. Hiai leng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh lel ahi.
Mihai in abante khepkhawm in amah sa ane hi.
Khut dim nih sepgimna leh huih nungdelhna sang in, lungmuanna toh khut dim khat ahoihzaw hi.
Huchi in ka kihei a ni nuai a bangmah lou ka mu hi.

Amah kia a om khat ka mu a, nihna anei kei a; ahi, tapa anei kei, sanggampa leng anei kei; hinapi in lah asepgim tawpna a-om kei a, hauhsakna in amitte leng alungkim tuan kei hi. "Kua a dia semgim a, ka kha hoih tansak ka hia?" achi a. Hiai leng bangmah lou ahi, ahi, nakpi a gimthuakna ahi.
Khat sang in nih ahoihzaw; asepgimna ua ding a kipahman hoih aneih ziak un.
Puk le uh, khat in alawm phong ding ahih ziak in; himahleh apuk chiang a amah kia a-om a, amah phong ding midang nei lou tung agik hi.
Huai lou in, nih alupkhawm un, lumna athei uh; himahleh khat kia bangchi in alum thei dia?
Huan mi khat in amah kia a om pen zouleh, nih in amah adou ding ua; khauzang guk a hek akitat mengmeng kei hi.
Kumpipa tek leh hai, thuhilhna sang thei nawn lou sang in tuailai genthei leh pil ahoihzaw hi.
Suangkul a kipan a kumpipa hi ding a hong paikhia lah ahi ngal a; ahi, ama gam mahmah a gentheisa a piang ahi.
Ni nuai a vak ahing tengteng, tuailaite toh om uh ahihleh, anihna, amun ah adingh chih ka muta hi.
Mi tengteng, amaute tung a a-omna mahmah, bei chih a-om kei a; hinapi in lah tunung chiang a hong om dingte amah ah akipak kei ding uh. Chihtaktak in hiai leng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh lel ahi.
